# Agent Harness for WordPress

> Agent Harness for WordPress: local disposable WordPress for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via the official MCP Adapter.

This Netlify site is the public marketing page. The WordPress harness itself runs on localhost only and is not hosted here.

## Primary

- [Home](https://wp-agent-harness.netlify.app/): Agent Harness for WordPress product page with quick start and FAQ
- [Markdown home](https://wp-agent-harness.netlify.app/index.md): Same content as plain Markdown
- [Privacy](https://wp-agent-harness.netlify.app/privacy.html): Marketing-site privacy notice
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/marcop135/wp-agent-harness): Source, Docker Compose, tests, docs

## Docs on GitHub

- [README](https://github.com/marcop135/wp-agent-harness#readme): Clone and connect
- [Agent docs](https://github.com/marcop135/wp-agent-harness/blob/develop/docs/AGENTS.md): MCP loop and harness rules
- [Architecture](https://github.com/marcop135/wp-agent-harness/blob/develop/docs/architecture.md): Stack diagram
- [Repo llms.txt](https://github.com/marcop135/wp-agent-harness/blob/develop/llms.txt): Hard rules for agents driving the local site

## Facts agents should not invent

- This repo does not ship an MCP server, abilities framework, or WordPress plugin.
- WordPress and MariaDB bind to 127.0.0.1 only.
- MCP meta-tools: discover-abilities, get-ability-info, execute-ability.
- Reset volumes with `./bin/reset`; `./bin/setup` is idempotent and does not wipe content.
